Action incidence source integration — v1_0 (19 November 2026)

Classification: Targeted source integration and finite-algebra E1/E2 replay; no claim of E3/E4 whole-paper re-audit. Current papers: I-B v1.18, III-A v1.178, III-F v1.272, V-A v3.216, within PapersMinimal v3_039. Preserved: Paper II-A physical co-realization theorem; primitive rooted fermion source; conditional charged preterminal assembly; no GP4.

The new finite theorems have distinct source owners and explicitly limit their quantified domains:

  • p1:prop:signed-target-image-rank: exact signed-Fock target map ranks and kernel; source geometry only.
  • p3a:prop:rooted-c3-split-preserving-closure: commutant stability under split-preserving arithmetic, functional calculus and Schur reduction.
  • p3f:prop:primitive-odd-complement-grading: odd primitive compression when grading-preserving projectors are used.
  • p5:cor:charged-c3-source-no-go: charged E36 mismatch bound for C3-only source closure.
  • p5:prop:charged-signed-return-distance: fixed-frame complex rank-eight image and optimal mismatch, charged lepton only.
  • p5:rem:charged-origin-two-route-test: zero-order mixed-jet and complete interacting-pole alternative routes; neither established by the new finite results.

Open original condition: p5:def:v228-hierarchy-origin / Cert_hier. The current physical Dirac/source constructor has NOT been shown to generate the target-spinor-sensitive charged source. No status promotion or novel physical action member is claimed.

Verification limits: The two independent existing exact symbolic witnesses were rerun and passed. Label counts, source uniqueness, ZIP contents and DAG anchor-map consistency were checked. This is not a full independent proof verification of all 31 papers or the new theorem's entire upstream physical ancestry.
